# Vendored liblcf CSV tables

These files are copied verbatim from EasyRPG/liblcf `generator/csv/` at commit
[666e6c0](https://github.com/EasyRPG/liblcf/tree/666e6c0/generator/csv):
`fields.csv`, `structs.csv`, `enums.csv`, `flags.csv`, `constants.csv`.

liblcf is MIT-licensed, Copyright (c) 2014-2025 liblcf authors. The full
notice is carried in the third-party section of the root [LICENSE](../../LICENSE).

They drive code generation in `scripts/generate.ts` → `src/generated/`.
